Thus we need to apply a template that splits the product into two precursors: aromatic aldehyde (maybe "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(C=O)cc2)cc1"? Actually the aldehyde would be on the phenyl attached to sulfonyl? The product has a phenyl-sulfonyl-phenyl-cinnamic acid. The aldehyde precursor would be the same phenyl-sulfonyl-phenyl-CHO (cinnamaldehyde). And malonic acid is HOOC-CH2-COOH.

Thus possible precursors: "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(C=O)cc2)cc1" and "OC(=O)CH2C(=O)O" (malonic acid). But also maybe the aldehyde could be on the other phenyl?
